lines.text: Many learners say: I am agree with you.
Agree is a verb. No am.

data.why: Agree is a verb. No am.

native.tip: Agree — глагол. Говори просто “I agree”, без “am”.
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I am agree with you.”? 😅 По-русски «я согласен» — это прилагательное, и в английский тянется “am”. Правильно: “I agree with you.”. Послушай Карлос и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.

en.tip: Agree is a verb. Just say “I agree”, with no “am”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I am agree with you.”? 😅 In Russian “ya soglasen” has a be-word, so “am” sneaks into English. Correct: “I agree with you.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
